Euphorbia Ipecacuanhæ.

Ipecacuan Spurge. N. O. Euphorbiaceæ. Powdered root.

Clinical.─Gastritis. Vomiting.

Characteristics.─E. ipecac. is a more active emetic than Ipecacuanha.

SYMPTOMS.

11. Stomach.─Active and long-continued vomiting with a sense of heat, vertigo, indistinct vision, and prostration.
